confirmed_normal.description:
Title:
Senior Principal Piping Stress Engineer
Job Responsibilities:
Review the client’s technical requirements for Piping Stress Engineering and establish the stress design basis/philosophy for various load cases, specification, standards and guidelines for stress engineering execution
Prepare stress critical line list as per the critical line selection criteria plan, schedule and progress control for the critical computer stress calculations and visual reviews
Perform static analysis using CAESAR II for the load cases such as dead weight, sustained loads, thermal expansion/contraction, wave acceleration, Hag/Sag Deflections, occasional and environmental loads, blast load, fatigue, slug, transportation, module lift and vibration analysis
Provide effective stress solution for the Topside modules critical Piping and Deck Piping which involves equipment’s such as Compressor, Turbines, Pumps, Vessels, Separator, Heat Exchangers and Pipe rack Piping, etc.
Selection of spring hangers, expansion joints and special supports and preparation of data sheets for the same
Provide technical solution for the non-critical line by performing visual reviews selection of spring hangers, expansion joints and special supports and preparation of data sheets for the same
Monitor, check and approve stress calculations as per the checking procedure
Collaborate well within team and communicate effectively with Piping Lead Engineer
Vendor drawing review for the static Equipment’s/Rotating Equipment’s/Packages and ensure all the piping loads are within the recommended limit Stress check on the IFC Isometrics/Pipe supports and preparation of stress Isometrics and stress reports
Job Requirements:
Degree in Mechanical Engineering with exposure to piping stress checks and supports design
Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in Oil and Gas FPSO/Offshore platforms/Petrochemical/Refinery industry
Should have worked as Senior Piping Stress Engineer/Lead Stress Engineer for FPSO/offshore Platform based Projects for a minimum of 10 years
Must be familiar with international standards such as ANSI/ASME/API standard for Piping Stress
Knowledge in NORSOK/UKCS/Australian standards
Has good written and verbal communications skills
Has sufficient work experience and knowledge in Piping layout/Design/Pipe support/E3D/S3D
Good interface knowledge with Process Engineering/Structural Engineering/Naval/Safety
Knowledge in Microsoft Office applications

Job Description
Overview
Join AtkinsRéalis as an Engineering Manager – Piping and Feeder Function within our Engineering Excellence team. In this leadership role, you will help deliver innovative engineering solutions for major nuclear power projects while leading a highly skilled team of engineering professionals. Working in a dynamic matrix organization, you will drive technical excellence, support project execution, and contribute to the future of nuclear energy in Canada.
Your Role
Provide technical management and leadership to a highly technical group in feeders, piping and supports design and analysis to accomplish the assigned project goals. This includes:
Approving technical documents and deliverables prepared by staff working under them.
Planning and executing work consistent with quality, cost and schedule requirements.
Removing barriers that would impact deliverables to meet project requirements and priorities, working with the assigned staff to find solutions and optimizations.
Providing technical advice to staff and as appropriate subject matter expertise to staff and management.
Participating in the preparation of commercial proposals and approving the technical content of proposals under their direction related to the new build project.
Forecasting resource demands for the assigned work scope, including skills, capabilities, and durations. Interfacing with clients and successfully delivering engineering products in accordance with customer specification and requirements.
The Manager will also oversee the work of 10 to 15 engineering staff. Supervisory responsibilities include:
Fostering a positive team environment where good performance is recognized and celebrated.
Coaching for improved performance.
Performing administrative tasks, e.g., timesheet approvals, vacation approvals.
Goal setting, Performance feedback and performance enhancement.
Training and Qualifications Planning and Management.
Forecasting resource needs and hiring for the function withing Engineering Excellence.
Working with marketing and other corporate groups to maintain and improve client relationships and offerings.
Initiate and execute organizational initiatives to improve efficiency, employee engagement and to foster collaborative environment.
Initiate and source appropriate resources through evaluation of resource demands.
About You
10+ years of licensing experience in a nuclear project environment, including experience leading engineering teams.
Knowledgeable of CANDU Feeder and Piping systems in design registration phases to degradation mechanisms for fitness for service-related areas.
Experience managing and/or performing work under nuclear Codes and Standards such as CSA N285 & ASME Section III and ASME B31.1 codes and any other applicable standards or regulatory guides related to permanent plant components, pressure boundary equipment, and/or reactor systems is preferred.
Design engineering experience in nuclear class 1, 2, 3 and 6 piping systems, valves, pumps and for Nuclear Power Plants is preferable.
Experience in feeder and piping systems design, layout, stress analysis and FEA methods.
Experienced in the interpretation of GD&T.
Knowledge of analytical tools used for mechanical design (e.g., ANSYS, Mathcad, LS-DYNA, GT-STRUDEL, ABAQUS, Solid Works, 3D SMART PLANT or similar) is an asset.
Ability to work to budget and schedule. Must be willing to travel occasionally to participate in walkdowns, meetings and workshops.
Proven leadership skills, as technical guidance to assist and supervise analysts with good communication skills.
Eligible for nuclear energy worker (NEW).
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Additional, preferred qualifications:
Engineering degree in a related engineering discipline.
Registered Professional Engineer in the Province of Ontario, qualified to seal engineering documents.
Experience managing and/or performing multidisciplinary work with significant interfacing requirements with interfacing disciplines such as licensing, safety analysis, mechanical, process control, and civil engineering.
Experience working in a nuclear facility licensed in Canada, or Candu Reactors highly preferable.
Willing to travel to and potentially work at Project sites to meet project needs (Note: the home location is at the Mississauga head office in Ontario).
Rewards & Benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career at AtkinsRéalis in Canada.
Enjoy competitive compensation, employee recognition, and a brilliant range of flexible benefits you can tailor to your health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle needs.
Make the most of diverse opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise.
And take advantage of our hybrid working culture and generous time-off policies to balance a fulfilling career with your personal life. https://careers.atkinsrealis.com/rewards-benefits-canada
